opportunity: kuna declares a byte whose every use is a truth test `char`, because `TYPE_BOOL` is only ever an op's OUTPUT type and `TypeOpEqual::get_input_local` votes `get_base(1, TYPE_INT)` -- the ASCII `char` -- for the value being compared. Over the 444-slice decbench type sweep, 3,228 ground-truth variables are `_Bool`; 2,057 of them are matchable (argument index or calibrated stack offset) and 1,129 of those are misses, 866 because kuna committed the byte to `char` (700) or `unsigned char` (166).
test_name: tests/stages/kuna-boolbyte.xml (10 two-pass assertions: one witness, five refusals incl. the two INDIRECT controls) + 4 unit tests on the fold order
inspiration: IDA's Hex-Rays declares a byte whose only uses are conditions as `bool`; its microcode carries a boolean operand kind for the same values. This rule reaches the same declaration through Ghidra's own lattice, by supplying the TYPE_BOOL candidate the getLocalType fold never has.

witness.after: void sub_2b45(unsigned long a0,long a1,bool a2)   /* JSON: {"name":"param_3","type":"bool","kind":"arg","arg_index":2,"size":1} */

benchmark.metric: decbench type_match (main), DECBENCH_NO_CACHE=1, both arms the same pinned binary
benchmark.slice_set: projects coreutils grep gzip diffutils bzip2 findutils tar shadow cronie dash kmod dpkg x O0/O2/O2-noinline (474 slices, 13276 functions) -- the 444-slice campaign set plus the four projects the bool-array defect was found in
benchmark.measured_on: re-run end to end on the final binary after the printer arm landed; totals are identical to the pre-arm run, as expected -- the arm moves C text in four functions and the metric scores the JSON variables[] surface.

classification: 89/100 functions change only declaration spellings (`char v` -> `bool v`, `char a0` -> `bool a0`) and the rendering of the flag constants they are assigned (`v = '\x01'` -> `v = 1`, `a1 == '\0'` -> `a1 == 0`), which is what a bool declaration should do to a flag.

4/100 lose a raw `SUBnn` p-code intrinsic: `v24 = SUB41(v29 >> 0x1f,0);` -> `v24 = (bool)(v29 >> 0x1f);` (du -O0 0x815c, find -O0 0x347a5, libedit -O2 0x25e80, tar -O2 0x41370).  `CastStrategyC::isSubpieceCast` has no TYPE_BOOL destination in its list, so without the option's printer arm a truncation into a bool falls to the functional form and emits an undeclared identifier.  Counts of the intrinsic therefore go DOWN, never up: whole-binary, tar -O2 4 -> 1, ls -O2 1 -> 0, du -O0 1 -> 0, grep -O2 0 -> 0; and 7 -> 0 counted over the 100 functions the option changes at all.  Three of those seven are cases a comparison alone had already made `bool` without this rule, so the arm also removes them; with the option off the printer is byte-for-byte unchanged.

6/100 change their declaration COUNT: typing a byte bool can split a speculative merge, so a flag and a byte load that shared one `unsigned char` declaration become two variables.  Net -4 declarations over the sixteen binaries.  The remaining `vN` locals renumber, which is most of the raw diff volume.

1/100 (grep -O2 0x109d0) moves the same way with the declaration count unchanged: one `unsigned char` splits into a `bool` and an `unsigned char`, so the array index in `*(unsigned long *)(a1[0x31] + a0 * 8) = v11[v32];` comes to name the other half.  Splitting a merge is not a loss of information, but it moves names, which is part of why the option is a judgment call.
no statement moved, no branch changed, no call was added or removed in any of the 100.

ZERO bool-typed ARRAY rows on the scored variables[] surface across all sixteen binaries -- the class of defect that produced `bool v2 [131088]` on a cronie fgets buffer.  cronie crond -O2 and crontab -O0, where it was found, now have 0 changed functions.

default_on_evaluation.why_not: Every mechanical criterion passes.  What holds it back is the seven merge-shape moves: typing a byte `bool` un-merges a speculative merge, so a declaration count and the name an expression uses can change, and that is a readability judgment rather than a correctness one.  The round-2 reviewer required the default stay off this round for that reason, and the measurement above is recorded so a flip can be a one-line PR with its evidence already in hand.
